Shadow.isVisible: if memory.HideGraphics<=0 and self.height>2 and parent.hp<=0 and self.resource.TileMode!=1

BoostReversing.isVisible: if self.speed>0.1 and ( parent.hp<=0 or (parent.hp<=0 and self.height>10) ) and ( ( memory.moveMode==1 and distanceBetween(self.getOffsetRelative(x=0,y=0.1),activeWaypointTarget)>distanceBetween(self,activeWaypointTarget) ) or (self.resource().TileMode==1 and memory.moveMode==0) )
